title: Annual coverage review offer
description: Invite customers to a free annual coverage review on WhatsApp to spot gaps and savings. Marketing template for insurance brokers.
notes: Offer one clear action, like booking a 15-minute call. Mentioning that the review is free and non-binding lowers opt-out rates.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, it has been a year since your last coverage check. Life changes, and your protection should too. Book a free 15-minute review with {{agent_name}} to see if you can save or close any gaps.
